review_candidates.title: Spacecraft and Satellite Configuration Design Engineer
review_candidates.description: Backed by NASA, DARPA, and Space Force, we are a venture backed, rapidly growing startup with the ultimate goal of asteroid mining through our space platforms. The space industry is a trillion dollar market and there is so much opportunity to further explore deep space. Our world class engineering team has created patented technologies, telescopes, and capture systems that are helping us get towards achieving our ultimate goal.  Position Overview We are seeking a Spacecraft and Satellite Configuration Design Engineer to define, develop and control the physical and functional configuration of satellite platforms and payloads from formulation through delivery and mission operations. The role will lead configuration design, interface definition, mass and balance control, and integration planning while coordinating structural, thermal, electrical and RF disciplines. The engineer will own configuration baselines, support AIT and environmental test campaigns (TVAC, vibration, shock), and ensure successful launch vehicle integration and mission support. Key Responsibilities Define and maintain spacecraft and satellite configuration baselines and change control processes throughout formulation, design, AIT and operations phases. Develop, review and release detailed mechanical and electrical configuration design using CAD (Catia, NX, SolidWorks , Creo) and ensure GD&T-compliant technical drawings and Bills of Materials (BOM). Perform or coordinate mass properties, center-of-gravity and balance analyses and maintain mass budgets and margin reports. Coordinate structural and thermal analyses (NASTRAN, ANSYS), tolerance and view-factor analyses, and interpret results to drive design changes with engineering teams. Plan, write and execute environmental test plans and procedures including thermal vacuum (TVAC), vibration, shock and EMI/EMC/ESD testing; support test campaigns and hardware qualification. Lead harness and wiring design and routing, avionic integration and PCB interface reviews; manage ICDs and electrical interface control to the EPS and data systems. Develop and maintain power budgets (EPS), load analysis and power system interfaces; coordinate attitude determination and control (ADCs) and thruster interfaces where relevant. Integrate RF/communications subsystems and antennas into the spacecraft configuration; support RF performance verification and antenna deployment validation. Design, review and verify deployable mechanisms, separation systems and associated verification testing and acceptance criteria. Own AIT/Assembly integration sequencing, GSE requirements and launch vehicle integration activities; provide technical direction to AIT teams and suppliers. Manage requirements and traceability using tools such as DOORS and Jama; author and maintain interface control documents (ICDs) and configuration documentation. Perform risk analyses, including FMEA/FTA, and contribute to mitigation plans; support configuration and change impact assessments and safety reviews. Support MBSE activities with SysML/model-based engineering tools; develop CAD-to-analysis workflows and scripts (Matlab/Simulink, Python) to automate configuration and mass property updates. Provide mission operations and proximity-operations support as required, assist with anomaly investigations, and produce clear technical reports and documentation for stakeholders. Required Qualifications 3+ years of experience supporting the design, development, or integration of spacecraft, satellites, or other highly engineered aerospace systems. Proficiency with 3D CAD tools used for mechanical design and system layout of complex assemblies; experience with SolidWorks, Creo, NX, CATIA, or similar platforms. Strong understanding of multidisciplinary spacecraft integration principles, including thermal, power, communications, attitude control, structures, and propulsion considerations. Experience conducting engineering trade studies and evaluating system-level configuration options to support concept development and vehicle architecture decisions. Ability to perform preliminary engineering assessments such as mass property calculations, power evaluations, geometric analyses, and thermal accommodation studies. Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or another relevant engineering discipline. Familiarity with spacecraft thermal design concepts, including radiator placement, solar array accommodation, environmental impacts, and system-level thermal considerations. Understanding of communications hardware integration, including antenna placement, field-of-view requirements, and vehicle accommodation constraints. Knowledge of spacecraft electrical power hardware packaging, including batteries, solar arrays, harness routing, and volume allocation considerations. Experience creating technical visualizations, engineering drawings, configuration layouts, and presentation-ready graphics to communicate design concepts effectively. Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic engineering environment with cross-functional teams and evolving project priorities. Eligibility to work on projects subject to U.S. export control regulations. Ability to work onsite as required. Preferred Qualifications Advanced degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience supporting early mission concept development, architecture studies, or Phase A/B spacecraft programs. Background in spacecraft hardware development through design reviews, integration and test activities, requirements management, or operational support. Familiarity with thermal analysis methodologies and tools, including coordination with thermal engineering teams during spacecraft development. Experience with deployable systems, mechanisms, robotics, capture systems, or other moving aerospace hardware. Knowledge of launch vehicle integration constraints, payload accommodations, and mission interface requirements. Experience with mass properties tracking, configuration management, and engineering data control processes. Exposure to advanced space applications such as in-space servicing, resource utilization, orbital logistics, debris mitigation, or deep-space/cislunar missions. Active security clearance, or the ability to obtain one. They own end-to-end delivery of integration offerings within defined scope, timeline, and budget, escalating only where customer requirements exceed standard package boundaries. Key Responsibilities Drive customer success and stickiness Own technical solution design for select customers: from scoping integrations and data workflows through to working implementations that enable full platform value. Deliver the standard Integration/Automation packages end-to-end: scope confirmation, project delivery, build, testing, and handoff within the defined timeline and effort budget. Advise customers and partners on integration architecture: how to connect Mitti to their existing systems effectively and sustainably. Partner with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to build implementation plans that accelerate time-to-value for managed accounts. Work alongside Account Executives (AEs) during pre-sales to communicate technical platform capabilities (APIs, security architecture, and cloud integrations) and resolve technical blockers in the sales cycle. Act as a technical bridge between GTM and PDE, capturing and routing customer integration feedback that shapes the product roadmap. Partner with the API and Integrations Engineering team to resolve complex customer requirements and advocate for platform improvements that benefit the broader customer base. Improve How We Deliver Identify recurring technical patterns across customer integrations, propose and participate in standardisation efforts: new packaged offerings, reusable automation, or templated solutions that reduce delivery effort across the customer base, not just for one account. Build and maintain technical automations (scripts, workflows, tooling) that reduce manual effort in the standard delivery motion, contributing them back to the shared Customer Solution & Implementation toolkit rather than keeping them account-specific. Flag when the same "out of scope" request appears repeatedly across customers, as a signal the package boundary itself needs to move, not just that this customer needs an exception. Able to navigate a wide variety of enterprise system architectures, data models, and integration patterns. Confident reading API documentation and building or troubleshooting API integrations in enterprise environments. Background spanning software development and data analytics; comfortable moving between building solutions and communicating data-driven insights to non-technical stakeholders. Behavioural Skills Translates fluently between technical and non-technical audiences: equally credible in an engineering deep-dive and a customer-facing session with business stakeholders. Stays organised across a high-volume, concurrent workload; switches context quickly without losing quality or missing detail. Customer-first problem solver: listens to understand the real need before proposing a solution, and brings options rather than just problems. Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity; exercises sound judgment on edge cases while operating within a defined delivery methodology. Team-first mindset: invests in the success of CSMs, AEs, and engineering partners, not just their own outcomes. Distinguishes clearly between solving a customer's immediate problem and identifying a systemic delivery improvement worth productising, and routes each appropriately. AI Skills Uses AI tools to accelerate integration work, drafting technical specs and documentation, analysing customer data to surface insights, and building automations faster. Applies AI coding assistants fluently in day-to-day work; evaluates AI-generated code for quality, correctness, and security before deploying. Proficient with AI tools: independently identifies where AI adds leverage in their workflows and adopts new capabilities without direction. Benefits At Mitti, we care about people and growing the team, through: Equity with high growth potential, and a competitive salary, Hybrid working arrangements with flexibility, Access to professional and personal training and development opportunities; Hackathons, Workshops, Lunch & Learns; We encourage involvement in the community, open source work, attending talks and events, and experimenting with new technologies. You'll Also Receive Other Perks Such As Remote flexible working arrangements Wellbeing initiatives such as subsidised fitness programs, EAP services and generous parental leave policy Quarterly celebrations and team events Table tennis, board games, gym sessions, book club, and pet-friendly offices. We’re committed to building inclusive teams and cultivating a sense of belonging so our people can bring their whole authentic selves to work each day. We seek to make reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process to create an even playing field for all candidates. Thanks to the tireless efforts of the entire Mitti team we’ve built an incredible culture which has seen us recognised as a Best Place to Work in Australia , the US and the UK . Even if you don't meet every requirement listed in the ad, please consider applying for this role. We prioritise inclusion and value individuals with potential over a checklist of qualifications. Don't rule yourself out, hit that apply button if this job resonates with you You can find out more about life at Mitti via Youtube , Twitter , Instagram and LinkedIn. To all recruitment agencies, we do not accept resumes or partnership opportunities. Please do not forward resumes to Mitti or any of our employees. We are not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resumes.

review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accounts Payable Specialist based in India. We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive finance professional to manage accounts payable and support core accounting operations within a growing, multi-entity SaaS business. In this role, you will oversee vendor invoice processing, corporate card transactions, bank reconciliations, and month-end closing activities across multiple entities and currencies. You will work closely with vendors, budget owners, and internal accounting teams to ensure accurate financial records, timely payments, and compliance with established policies. Using tools such as NetSuite and modern spend management platforms, you will help maintain efficient financial workflows and resolve discrepancies. This opportunity is ideal for someone who combines strong accounting fundamentals with analytical thinking, organization, and a commitment to accuracy. You will contribute directly to reliable financial reporting, audit readiness, and the continuous improvement of accounting processes in a remote working environment. Accountabilities Accounts payable and invoice processing: Manage vendor invoices from receipt through payment preparation, including invoice verification, purchase order and contract validation, general ledger coding, and approval routing. Vendor management: Validate vendor onboarding information, tax documentation, and banking details while maintaining accurate and up-to-date vendor records. Resolve vendor queries, duplicate invoices, payment exceptions, and other accounts payable discrepancies. Corporate card and expense management: Review and code corporate and virtual card transactions to the appropriate general ledger accounts, departments, and legal entities. Follow up with cardholders for missing receipts, expense descriptions, and supporting documentation while ensuring compliance with company spending policies. Account reconciliations: Reconcile corporate card, expense, and spend management clearing accounts, investigate variances, and ensure outstanding items are resolved promptly. Bank accounting and reconciliations: Record bank transactions in the general ledger across US and international entities. Prepare monthly bank reconciliations across multiple banks and currencies, investigate discrepancies, and clear outstanding reconciling items. Intercompany transactions: Process intercompany payments and coordinate funding requests to ensure transactions are accurately recorded and settled across entities. Customer cash application: Identify customer receipts from bank activity and apply payments to the correct invoices within the billing system, maintaining accurate customer account balances. Month-end close: Complete assigned closing activities and balance sheet reconciliations within established deadlines, ensuring all entries are accurate and supporting documentation is available for review. ERP and financial records: Maintain accurate employee and vendor records within the ERP system and ensure financial transactions are documented in accordance with internal accounting procedures. Audit support: Prepare schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation required for external audits, helping ensure financial records are complete and audit-ready. Stakeholder coordination: Collaborate with the accounting team, budget owners, cardholders, and vendors to resolve issues, maintain timely transaction processing, and improve communication across finance operations. Workflow monitoring and improvement: Track accounting and month-end close activities, communicate progress, identify potential delays, escalate blockers proactively, and recommend improvements to recurring financial processes. Requirements Professional experience: 2–4 years of experience in accounts payable, general accounting, or a related finance function, preferably within a SaaS or technology company. ERP expertise: Hands-on experience with NetSuite, including invoice processing, general ledger coding, vendor record maintenance, and related accounting workflows. Spend management tools: Practical experience with corporate card and spend management platforms such as Airbase, Ramp, Brex, or similar systems. Bank reconciliation experience: Proven ability to prepare and review bank reconciliations across multiple entities, banking relationships, and currencies. Accounting knowledge: Solid understanding of accrual accounting, general ledger processes, intercompany transactions, balance sheet reconciliations, and month-end closing procedures. Accounts payable operations: Experience processing vendor invoices, validating supporting documentation, coding card expenses, managing vendor records, and resolving payment discrepancies. Financial accuracy and compliance: Strong attention to detail, with a commitment to maintaining accurate financial records, complete audit trails, and properly documented transactions. Time management and organization: Ability to manage recurring accounting responsibilities, prioritize competing tasks, meet month-end close deadlines, and identify potential delays before they affect delivery. Analytical skills: Strong problem-solving abilities and the capacity to investigate variances, identify the causes of discrepancies, and implement appropriate corrective actions. Communication and collaboration: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with vendors, cardholders, budget owners, and internal finance teams. Spreadsheet proficiency: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for reconciliation support, transaction analysis, and financial reporting. Additional advantages: Familiarity with billing platforms such as Orb, customer cash application processes, and US or international vendor tax documentation, including 1099 forms. Audit and multi-entity experience: Previous exposure to external audits and accounting operations across multiple legal entities is an advantage. Professional mindset: A proactive, organized, accountable, and collaborative approach to problem-solving, process improvement, and financial operations. Benefits Competitive salary: Annual compensation ranging from INR 13 lakh to INR 16 lakh (LPA). Fully remote work: Work remotely from India, offering flexibility in your work environment. Full-time employment: Opportunity to build expertise in a dedicated finance and accounting role within a multi-entity SaaS business. Exposure to modern financial technology: Hands-on experience with NetSuite and spend management tools such as Airbase, Ramp, and Brex. Professional development: Opportunities to strengthen expertise in accounts payable, general accounting, multi-currency reconciliations, and month-end close processes. Cross-functional collaboration: Work with accounting professionals, vendors, and internal stakeholders across finance operations.
